# Which Amazon search terms are burning your ad budget, and which deserve more?

> Free Amazon PPC search term analyzer: drop in your Sponsored Products search term report CSV and see wasted ad spend graded by evidence, negative keyword candidates, terms to harvest into exact match with break-even bids, and spend above your target ACOS. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
